android.desc:
Santa's elves made many a Christmas Gifts for all good kids in the world. But an Evil Sorcerer turned those gifts into monsters. The monsters left the North Pole and wandered into the Frosty Forest.

Santa is out, roaming in the Frosty Forest to SNOWBALL these Monsters so they can turn back into Christmas Gifts for the good kids.

Help Santa move about in the forest. Throw snowballs at monsters to change them back into gifts. The go pick those gifts up.
For every five picked gifts, Santa gains a heart back that it looses as health while fighting monsters. Santa can jump over the monsters, if not able to throw. 

But be strong, you need to help.. so that Santa Saves Xmas.
